title: Easy mode question in the 2 player demo
why: His answer Q66 (2026-10-18): the game asks the players if they want easy mode. In the 2 player demo, after a player drops back in from his second death of the run with no extraction yet, a short card asks once per window: Y or A yes, N or B no, 12 s with no answer is a no. Yes takes 30 percent off the damage he takes (the Forgiving setting). Only the arcade layer reads it, so normal raids and the seed 4242 fingerprint do not move.
now: The 2 player demo now asks once if you want easy mode after your second death.
